title: Synchronize single-image rank witnesses on a common neighbourhood
statement: Let f:X\to S be a morphism of schemes, E a finite locally free module on X, and g:T\to S. Assume the structure-sheaf adjunction unit is an isomorphism after every base change [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. If R_1(f,E,E,g) and R_1(f,E,E^\vee,g) both hold [def-sc-picard-universal-single-rank-match], then R(f,E,g) holds [def-sc-picard-universal-rank-match]. Thus the ranks and neighbourhoods in the two assumptions can be synchronized; no representing scheme is asserted.

source.place: first and third proof paragraphs: the two single-image loci use the same rank of E

proof.text: For each further base change h and point t, obtain U,r and V,s from the two single-rank conditions. Set W = U intersection V. Compare tensorPullback with Modules.pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints; the source-library isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_pullback instance then gives fixed-rank preservation for tensor pullback. Tensor-pullback composition and Scheme.homOfLE_ι restrict the two direct images to W. For the reference module construct the canonical map X_W to X_U (and X_V) by pullback.lift; its first projection identity and tensor-pullback composition restrict both reference ranks to the same module on X_W.

The open W contains t, hence is nonempty. Apply the structure-sheaf unit hypothesis directly to W to S. If X_W were empty, Modules.isZero_of_isEmpty would make its tensor-pulled structure module zero. Pushforward preserves zero objects, so the unit isomorphism would make the structure module on W zero, contradicting the proved source-library Modules.not_isZero_unit. Thus choose x in X_W. The reference module has ranks r and s on X_W; finiteLocallyFreeOfRank_stalk_finrank applied twice at x gives r=s.

Substitute r for s and use W, its membership witness, and the three transported fixed-rank proofs as the common witness. This is the defining condition of PicardUniversalRankMatch for each h,t. For empty test schemes there is no t, and the stalk-finrank theorem also covers rank zero.

proof_origin.note: N1 implements the intersection argument with proved private restriction and nonemptiness helpers. Nonemptiness is detected on W itself rather than a residue-field fibre. No new statements or holes; unit route unchanged.

lean.statement: theorem picardUniversalRankMatch_of_singleRankMatch {X S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (hO : ∀ {T' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : T' ⟶ S), IsIso ((Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g'))).unit.app (SheafOfModules.unit T'.ringCatSheaf))) (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] (g : T ⟶ S) (hE : PicardUniversalSingleRankMatch f E E g) (hdual : PicardUniversalSingleRankMatch f E (Modules.dual E) g) : PicardUniversalRankMatch f E g
